Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 99: August 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #99 shipped to subscribers in July 2009 (bearing the cover date of August 2009 for Issue 99). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #99 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, Summer of Arcade content, and exclusive previews:

Batman: Arkham Asylum (action-adventure stealth)
Mini Ninjas (action-adventure platformer)
Dirt 2 (off-road racing simulation)
Trials HD (Xbox Live Arcade physics-based motorcycling puzzle-platformer)
Shadow Complex (Xbox Live Arcade 2.5D Metroidvania action-adventure)
TMNT: Turtles in Time Re-Shelled (Xbox Live Arcade 3D beat 'em up remake)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Modern Warfare 2, Left 4 Dead 2, and Assassin's Creed II, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
